root_cause.text: The function __nfulnl_send() uses nlmsg_put() to construct an NLMSG_DONE message without initializing the nfgenmsg payload, leaking uninitialized kernel heap data to userspace.
root_cause.evidence: The patch description states: "nlmsg_put() helper only zeroes alignment padding after the payload, not the payload itself, so four bytes of stale kernel heap data are leaked to userspace in the NLMSG_DONE message body." The fix replaces nlmsg_put() with nfnl_msg_put() which initializes the nfgenmsg payload via nfnl_fill_hdr().

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix netfilter logging by using nfnl_msg_put to properly initialize the nfgenmsg header with the multicast group number in NLMSG_DONE messages.
intent_record.what: Replaced nlmsg_put() with nfnl_msg_put() in __nfulnl_send(), changing the parameters from (skb, 0, 0, NLMSG_DONE, sizeof(struct nfgenmsg), 0) to (skb, 0, 0, NLMSG_DONE, 0, AF_UNSPEC, NFNETLINK_V0, htons(inst->group_num)).
intent_record.how: The new helper nfnl_msg_put() correctly fills the nfgenmsg header (family, version, res_id) and sets the multicast group number as res_id, ensuring that the NLMSG_DONE message carries the proper group context for nfnetlink logging.

This argument specifies the size of the nfgenmsg header within the NLMSG_DONE message; without initialization after nlmsg_put, the header payload contains uninitialized data.

And use nlmsg_data() while we're here too.

Signed-off-by: David

commit d550d0958928889fa7978b3e254edcd6c52c3296
Author: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>
Date:   Tue Jun 26 21:34:03 2012 -0700

    netfilter: nfnetlink_log: Move away from NLMSG_PUT().
    
    And use nlmsg_data() while we're here too.
    
    Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c b/net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c
index 3c3cfc0cc9b5..169ab59ed9d4 100644
--- a/net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c
+++ b/net/netfilter/nfnetlink_log.c
@@ -32
bic_trace_step.reason: In the __nfulnl_send function after this commit, nlmsg_put is called with sizeof(struct nfgenmsg) for NLMSG_DONE, but the nfgenmsg payload is never initialized (lines: if (inst->qlen > 1) { struct nlmsghdr *nlh = nlmsg_put(...); if (!nlh) goto out; }). The missing initialization leaves kernel heap data uninitialized, matching the vulnerability root cause. No fix (initialization) is added.
